title: All long store descriptions advertise the disabled local web server
reproduction: Read the final paragraph of any of the 70 long store descriptions, then compare with the current web-server availability flag and unavailable preference binding. The listing promises an option that this build deliberately does not expose.
expected: Current store descriptions advertise available features only; a disabled native feature is omitted or explicitly identified as unavailable.
observed: All 70 fully read long descriptions retain the local-web-server promise. WEB_SERVER_ENABLED is false; isWebServerAvailable returns it and the preference is unchecked/disabled. This is a metadata defect, not a request to re-enable native code.
fix: Remove or qualify only the local-server availability claim in the base English description and every localized/fallback long description; retain supported custom-IP host redirection and root/VPN descriptions.
test_evidence: Source comparison only; no Android runtime in this lane. Smallest regression: metadata capability check for English/fallback server claims plus translator review of the 70 final paragraphs while the availability flag remains false.

title: Saved import screenshot is not a decodable PNG
reproduction: Open docs/screenshots/import_final.png with an image decoder. A read-only host PNG signature/chunk/CRC check also rejects it immediately.
expected: A checked-in .png screenshot opens as an image and can be visually reviewed.
observed: view_image returned invalid or unsupported image data; file identifies data rather than PNG. First bytes are fffeeb0050004e004700 instead of 89504e470d0a1a0a. File has a UTF-16LE BOM. No visual-content claim is made; it is omitted from the full-review coverage CSV.
fix: Recover or replace the screenshot from a known original using binary-safe transfer, or remove the unused corrupt artifact with owner approval. Do not silently transcode damaged image bytes or treat the replacement as current runtime proof.
test_evidence: Executed read-only host checks: 18 of 19 scoped PNGs passed signature/chunk bounds/CRC/zlib checks; this file failed. Viewer also failed. Smallest regression: require PNG signature and successful image decode for every committed documentation PNG. No APK/runtime consequence established.
